name: Pirates

variantInfo.name: Pirate
notes: Aggressive; attacks with slash and can hit up to 4.
Found in the single-way Pirates' Hideout in the Wilderness (level 54).
A lockpick and 39 Thieving are required to open the door.

variantInfo.name: Zombie pirate
notes: Undead; 50% weak to fire spells, so Salve amulet and fire spells boost damage.
Found around the Chaos Temple in the low-level Wilderness; an alternative to the Pirates' Hideout.
Attacks with crush and hits low (up to 3).

locationComparison.name: Pirates' Hideout
notes: Wilderness level 54; a lockpick and 39 Thieving are required to open the door.
Single-way combat building; the pirates are aggressive.
Deep Wilderness - PKer risk; the wiki does not document a cannon or safespot here.

locationComparison.name: Chaos Temple (Wilderness)
notes: Zombie pirates spawn around the Chaos Temple in the low-level Wilderness.
Undead and weak to fire; easier and lower-risk than the Pirates' Hideout.
Cannon and safespot are not wiki-documented here (conservative defaults).

taskNotes: Pirates are assigned only by Krystilia and only count when killed inside the Wilderness.
The main assignable pirates are in the Pirates' Hideout (Wilderness level 54); a lockpick and 39 Thieving are required to open the door.
Zombie pirates around the Chaos Temple also count towards the task; they are undead and weak to fire, and are lower-risk.
Krystilia block cost is 100 Slayer reward points.
The slayerTargetId 267 is SYNTHETIC (C2/C3 allocation contract, worklist section 1); the real SLAYER_TARGET varp value is a QA live-verify item.
recommendedMethod: Melee any decent weapon at the Pirates' Hideout (bring a lockpick and 39 Thieving), or kill the undead Zombie pirates at the Chaos Temple with fire spells or a Salve amulet for a safer, lower-level alternative. Always beware PKers in the Wilderness.
